args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an elevated error rate (0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed with status `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident**: Created a **SEV2** incident for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows v2.3.0 healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback restored a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
